payload.title: A+ 结构 gate：A/B/AB 消融 + matched-state history test

payload.ablation: On top of additive-context base, B-modulation beats A-modulation decisively (H20: -67.3% vs -41.8%); AB adds only 7.6-9.4% over B-only.
payload.matched_state: Same current state + similar command, different history -> 3.24x larger next-step response difference (n=199).
payload.interpretation: History-conditioned control-channel B(c) modulation is the empirically dominant mechanism; strong motivation for A+ (RSHC-TK).
